tour_id.description: Unique identifier for the tour in the TourRadar system.

departure_id.description: Unique identifier of the departure date. For a list of departure dates, use the **[/tours/{tourId}/departures](#tag/Pricing-and-Availability/paths/~1v1~1tours~1{tourId}~1departures/get)** endpoint.`

currency.description: Currency code for the booking. The default is `USD`.

email.description: Email address for the lead passenger.

user_country.description: Identifier for the country of residence of the main passenger. Country IDs can be obtained from the **[/taxonomy/destinations/country](#tag/Taxonomy/paths/~1v1~1taxonomy~1destinations~1{type}/get)** endpoint.

passengers.description: List of passengers. Each entry represents one passenger.

pax_number.description: Passenger identifier, starting from 1. If the booking contains 5 passengers, the values must be from 1 to 5.

price_category_id.description: Price category ID retrieved from the **[/tours/{tourId}/prices](#tag/Pricing-and-Availability/paths/~1v1~1tours~1{tourId}~1prices/get)** endpoint.

fields.description: A set of key-value pairs containing passenger information. For a list of the available and mandatory keys, use the **[/operators/{operatorId}/booking-fields](#tag/Operators/paths/~1v1~1operators~1{operator}~1booking-fields/get)** endpoint.

accommodations.description: Accommodation requested, and assignment to passengers.

id.description: Unique identifier of the selected accommodation, taken from the **[/tours/{tourId}/departures/{departureId}](#tag/Pricing-and-Availability/paths/~1v1~1tours~1{tourId}~1departures~1{departureId}/get)** endpoint.

passengers.description: List of `pax_number` identifiers that should be placed in the selected accommodation.

optional_extras.description: Optional extras requested, and assignment to passengers.

id.description: Unique identifier of an optional extra, taken from the **[/tours/{tourId}/departures/{departureId}](#tag/Pricing-and-Availability/paths/~1v1~1tours~1{tourId}~1departures~1{departureId}/get)** endpoint.

passengers.description: List of `pax_number` identifiers for which this optional extra is being booked.

partner_booking_code.description: the booking code, or reference number, in your system. This will be stored with the booking, and returned with the booking detail request.

custom_data.description: Additional info set by the partner when creating the booking. Up to 5 string properties can be set in it.

store_id.description: Identifier of the store, or agency, that made the booking. Note: this is only relevant for bookings made via the TourRadar Partner API.
